Strategy: Test the item-scaled winning band here, rewarding and penalizing half an item for the twenty-eight to forty-two window and slivers. It may help if the item-scaled win generalizes across seeds, but may fail if it was specific to the other seed.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
